name: billing-details-section
title: Billing details section
description: What appears on invoices: company, address, a tax number checked for format and live, billing emails as chips and a reference, saved as one block.
docs: onSave may return a message (shown by the Save button), an object of messages keyed by field (shown against the fields), or nothing. onValidateTaxId resolves true or false for the live "Valid" or "Could not verify"; it runs once the number has the right shape. taxIdLabels adds or changes a country's label, example and pattern over the built-in table in tax-ids.ts. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
